title: Everyday Phrases — Picnic in the Park
scene_zh: 公園野餐 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧺 實用公園野餐必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Picnic in the Park
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的公園野餐情境對話，從前一天準備野餐籃、到公園鋪野餐布、開吃玩耍，再到收拾回家，全程真實對話流程（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Picnic in the Park phrase pairs, following a whole Saturday picnic day: packing the basket the night before, finding a shady spot, sharing food, playing frisbee, and packing up to go home (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們來計畫明天的野餐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll get a pen and paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many sandwiches do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a mat as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it be a sunny day?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the ice in the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many cups do we have?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我已經做好六個三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我把它們包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you check the ice box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on top of the mat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 吐司、起司、水果、果汁、冰塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lake is right in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚能在這裡過夜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, a day trip is best.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，一日遊就已經很棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the wind found the corner.
dialogue.zh: 風又去掀那個翹起來的角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's sit out of the wind.
dialogue.zh: 我們坐到避風的那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That dog is staring at us.
dialogue.zh: 那隻狗一直盯著我們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wants a sandwich, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 牠肯定是想討三明治吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把它插進土裡，插深一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and don't miss your neck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 防蚊液和防曬都擦好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那隻狗也跑去加入他們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, look at all this food.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the bottom of the basket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 籃子得挪到更陰涼的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, a fly just landed.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，有隻蒼蠅剛停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有最後一件事要調整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 裝三明治的盤子滑動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在我們真的準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那我會把自己的杯子蓋好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Raise your cup and say cheers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We planned this all just right.
dialogue.zh: 我們把這一天安排得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 果汁灑到我的襯衫上了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dab it with a wet wipe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toss the wrapper in the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it! My turn to throw.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one is hard to catch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll run and get it back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring it here and throw again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, watch this throw.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 連小小的碎紙也不放過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 公園才能一直漂漂亮亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 整整齊齊一方塊，摺得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把籃子傾斜過來抖一抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it out of the soil.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，它夾到我的手指了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 出發前先去把手洗乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在把東西放進後車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the photos came out great.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他說看起來像做夢一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 下次一定要邀他一起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we come back next week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好，同一棵樹同一個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 開回家的路上放音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我已經想再野餐一次了。
